title: Reprise sombre des 30 autres icônes compactes

authorization.quote: ca me plait bien mieux, ca veut dire aussi qu'il faut refaire les autres :)
authorization.scope: Adopt the somber direction for the remaining 30 existing compact designs; new individual drawings remain review candidates.

candidates.title: Vitalité améliorée
candidates.roleplay: Votre corps renforcé supporte davantage de blessures avant de céder.
candidates.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: ONE square compact skill icon for Project RL, a serious dark cyberpunk and demonic roguelike. Input image 1 is the previous icon: retain its skill subject and main semantic identity, NOT its bright sticker palette or outer border. Input image 2 is the preferred new GRIM STYLE reference: match its rough inked and painted comic material treatment. Design for native 32 and 64 pixels first: ONE dominant emblem using very few broad shapes and bold internal gaps, filling about 90% of the square. Use visible MEDIUM-value front-facing planes, deep black recesses, rough steel / dirty bone / ash / blood-red materials as appropriate. Limited colored accents belong to the skill; no tiny dense texture. The mature industrial horror mood is stern, threatening and worn, never cute or heroic. NO continuous pale outer outline, NO shiny jewel facets, NO decorative white sticker rim, NO polished toy-like geometry. Local steel or bone highlights only; do not make the whole subject too dark to read at 32 pixels. Opaque near-black background, no backdrop, no scene, no frame, no typography, letters or logos. Keep the complete emblem in frame. No tiny embellishments or unnecessary parts. Output a single finished square icon.
Skill identity: Vitalité améliorée.
Subject: An anatomical human heart, recognizable ventricles and two broad blood vessels, deep red fleshy muscle, a few lighter wet planes and dark torn recesses. Keep it one central organ, neither armor nor a medical cross, no torso or hands. Grim physical resilience, not a cute red heart symbol.
